fieldValues.title: Domains nest: Deep context holds the narrower domains, by perspective
fieldValues.decision_question: Can domains be nested, and where does the need to hold deep context sit?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (srs-programme#95); awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: Parent: broaden the Semantic records domain instead of a new one. Mechanism: a new method relation between domain records instead of container nesting. Children: also nest Evidence-backed writing (not chosen now).
fieldValues.decision_statement: Domains can be nested. A new domain, Deep context, is the bigger need to hold meaning and provenance over time. Agent memory (the srs-context domain, holding agent context), Semantic records and Group meaning ownership nest within it for now. Nesting uses the existing container mechanism (childContainerIds, RFC-034), so a parent's effective membership includes its children's members and no core or package change is needed. Hierarchy can be a matter of perspective, not absolute: a domain may sit under more than one parent, and no single-parent or strict-tree rule is added. Time will tell.
